translation.name: In yancuic mononotzalistli ica Totecohtzin Jesucristo

book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: IN TLAHCUILOLAMATL ICA INOHQUE AQUIN QUINTOCAHHUIYAHQUE IN HEBREOHTECOS

content: In Jesús ocachi hueyi tequisca quen in Moisés

Nocnihuan, mechsecnintlalilohtoc in Dios huan mechnotzalohtoc mamochihuacan tehuaxcahuan. Ic inon xicchihuacan cuenta yec ica Cristo Jesús, tetlatitlanil huan in hueyixtoc den tiopixcamen aquin tlicanalotoc ica totlaneltoquilis.

Tleca Jesús ilohuac tetlacamatini ica in Dios, aquin otetocahhuiloc ica tetequiu, ijcon noyojqui quen Moisés ocatca tetlacamatini ipan itequiu ica in tetlacahuan aquin mochihuasque techanihcahuan in Dios.
Huan in Jesús tenamiquis ocachi mahuesyotl quen in Moisés, tleca Yehhuatzin oquimpehualtiloc in tetlacahuan in Dios huan in Moisés ocatca san se de yehhuan.
Huan masque in Jesús in aquin oquimpehualtiloc in tetlacahuan Dios, Yehhuatzin in Dios aquin oquimochihuiloc nochin tlen oncan.
Ijcon tel, in Moisés ocatca tetlacamatini quen tetlapalehuihcau ica nochin tetlacahuan in Dios. In itequiu san ic quichipahuiya ica in tlahtoli tlen panos satepa.

Huan Cristo no tetlacamatini quen Teconetzin aquin tlatequiutilos ica tetlacahuan in Dios huan ahmo san quen tlapalehuiyani. Huan axan tehhuanten titetlacahuan, tla ijcon ticpixtiyesque totemachilis hasta ticahsisque in tlen ticchixticaten.
In nesehuilistli ica in tetlacahuan in Dios
Ijcon quen mihtohua in Itiotonaltzin in Dios ipan Itlahcuiloltzin:

content.text: Axan ihcuac nanquicaquisque tlen Dios mihtohua,
ahmo ximochihuacan quenin aquin ahmo tetlacamatihque quen oquichiuque yehhuanten aquin ahmo onechcajque ipan in acahualtlahtli ipan inon tonali.
Huan ompa ahmo onechcajque in namochichicacoluan, masque ipan inon ompohuali xihuitl oquitaque nochin tlen onicchiu.
Ic inon onicualan ica inohque tlacamen,
huan ahmo oquinejque quixmatisque in noohtli.”
Huan ic inon onicualan ica yehhuan huan oniquincaquilti ica chicahualistli, ahmo calaquisque canin mosehuisque nohuan.

content: Yeh in tlen omoluic in Dios ica tochichicacoluan.
Nocnihuan, ximomaluican ahmo maye niyan se de namehhuan ahmo yolcuali ic mamoxelo den Dios yolihuatoc, ic ahmo teneltocas Yehhuatzin.
Tlahmo oc noncua, seya huan oc seya mostli ximoyolchicahuacan ic ayamo tlami in tonali den temaquixtilistli, huan ijcon niyan aquin de namehhuan maye moyolcahcayauto ica in tlahtlacoli.
Tla ic itlamiyan timochixtiyesque totemachilis ica tlen oticpiyayahque ic achto, ijcon nele tipohuihque tehuan Cristo.

content.text: Axan tel, ihcuac nanquicaquihque tlen mihtohua in Dios,
ahmo ximochihuacan quen in aquin ahmo tetlacamatihque, quen ocatcahque inohque aquin otecualantihque.

content: Tel, ¿aquin inohque oquicajque tetlahtol in Dios huan satepa oteixtlasque? Ocatca nochten inohque aquin oquinquixti in Moisés ipan in tlali Egipto.
Tel, ¿aquin inuan ocualanohualtoya in Dios ipan inon ompohuali xihuitl? Tlahmo ica yehhuan aquin ijcon otlahtlacolanque, huan ic inon omijque ipan in acahualtlahtli.

Huan tel, ¿aquin inohque oquincaquiltiloc in Dios ica chicahualistli ahmo calaquisquiyanihque ipan in tlali tlen in Dios quinmomacanilo ic mosehuisquiyanihque, tlahmo yehhuan aquin ahmo otetlacamatque?
Ijcon ticmatihque ahhuel ocalajque tleca ahmo oteneltocaque.
